createProjectDialog.title: Create Project
createProjectDialog.introduction: A Project brings members, Agents, discussions, assets, and execution history together through tasks. It does not include a team-shared local directory or create a dedicated Project Agent.
createProjectDialog.descriptionPlaceholder: What will this Project accomplish together?
createProjectDialog.workspaceNotice: After creation, each current member gets a private execution workspace in this Project, linked to their current device with a default working directory prepared. No dedicated Project Agent is created. Agent outputs flow back to the Project and are shared according to team permissions.
